8/25/2026 - Fragmentary Order - Gamescom Video
2026/8/25 - 碎片化指令 - Gamescom 视频

If you are here from the video/new hype for FragO and are looking to get started, you will be forced to start in Act 3 for the duration of the event which began on 8/19/2026. The event specific section of the guide is Act 3 - 3.5 News Articles. HOWEVER, you should continue reading this page so you can better understand what all is going on and how to navigate this web puzzle.
如果你是从视频/ FragO 的新热度来到这里并想开始游玩，那么在 2026/8/19 开始的本次活动期间，你将被迫从第三幕开始。指南中活动专属的部分是第三幕 - 3.5 新闻文章。但是，你应该继续阅读本页，以便更好地了解正在发生的一切以及如何浏览这个网络谜题。

It is VERY IMPORTANT that you keep your Codes private, they are unique to each player.

非常重要的一点是，请对你的代码保密，它们对每位玩家都是唯一的。

Using this Guide  使用本指南

Due to the sheer amount of loops and data in this project, we have decided to use document tabs over to the left.
由于本项目中有大量的循环和数据，我们决定使用左侧的文档标签页。

You may need to “Hide Outlines”, to see all the different document tabs.
你可能需要“隐藏大纲”，才能看到所有不同的文档标签页。

✅ = Solved  ✅ = 已解决

❌ = Not Solved
❌ = 未解决

🟧 = In-Progress  🟧 = 进行中


(Acts 1 and 2 get you familiar with the site and story and earn you some CR for use in Act 3, plus save a cost of 42k CR later.)
（第 1 幕和第 2 幕会让你熟悉网站和故事，并为你赚取一些 CR，供第 3 幕使用，还能在之后节省 42k CR 的费用。）

The cor3.gg site makes use of various virtual programs, some of which require exact specific commands to be run. Others are just clicked.
cor3.gg 网站使用了各种虚拟程序，其中一些需要运行精确的特定命令。其他的只需点击即可。


Any TERMINAL commands will be formatted like this - Auth_check BxfBj
任何终端命令都将采用这种格式——Auth_check BxfBj

Any Corie Database queries via the messenger are formatted - PERSON Simon Webb
通过信使进行的任何 Corie 数据库查询都采用这种格式——PERSON Simon Webb

Any Server names from the Act 3 Network Map will be formatted - RM7-E1L3
第三幕网络地图中的所有服务器名称都将被格式化 - RM7-E1L3

Any Files or Logs found on Network Map Servers will be formatted - export_6021.bak
网络地图服务器上找到的所有文件或日志都将被格式化 - export_6021.bak


Complete all Daily tasks as soon as they are available, you need 7 complete for step 6! You can redo them without a penalty, if you fail.
每日任务一出现就尽快完成，第 6 步需要完成 7 个！如果失败，可以重做且不受惩罚。


Various parts of the site have limited uses with a timeout to refresh, a bit like energy in a mobile game. Leveling up your reputation increases these limits.
网站的各个部分都有使用次数限制，并设有刷新超时，有点像手机游戏里的体力。提升声望等级会增加这些上限。

The Browser has a limit on page loads, each page load uses 50MB of your limit. The browser does not give an exact time it will refresh, simply 4 hours after the first page load.
浏览器有页面加载次数限制，每次加载页面会消耗你限额中的 50MB。浏览器不会给出确切的刷新时间，只会在首次页面加载 4 小时后刷新。

The Terminal has limited uses, which will be shown after running a command.
终端有使用次数限制，运行命令后会显示。

The CORIE Database also has limited uses
CORIE 数据库也有使用次数限制

All of the limited uses are seemingly increased with the increase of your reputation level which is shown in the top right of the website.
所有使用次数限制似乎都会随着声望等级的提升而增加，声望等级显示在网站右上角。

Timegates that we’ve included in the document are subject to change, and some have decreased already.
我们在文档中列出的时间节点可能会变动，其中一些已经提前了。

Patchnotes are now visible in the CORIE Updater.
补丁说明现已在 CORIE 更新器中可见。

Video Walkthrough Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough by ‘ImGoingSpace

You’ll start here, follow the guide through talking to Aurana, you’ll then end up in 1 of 4 investigation loops. You need to complete all 4 investigations before progressing to the final step of decoding trade shipments.  
你将从这里开始，按照指南与 Aurana 对话，然后会进入 4 个调查循环中的 1 个。你需要完成全部 4 项调查，才能推进到解码贸易货物的最后一步。

You end ACT 1 by purchasing your ticket to Mars via the M7 ship for 4,500 credits. You’ll need to complete at least 7 Daily tasks to top up the amount you get from tasks.
你通过 M7 飞船以 4,500 信用点购买前往火星的船票，从而结束 ACT 1。你需要完成至少 7 个每日任务，以补足从任务中获得的金额。

ACT 2 (Solved)  ACT 2（已解决）

After clicking “Depart” on the M7 ship, you will get a message from Aurana telling you to collect your things and you’ll go back outside the terminal. Click the Armor on the left table, the bag on the floor and on the shelf above the bag, the small white device.
在 M7 飞船上点击“Depart”后，你会收到 Aurana 发来的消息，让你收拾东西，然后你会回到航站楼外。点击左侧桌子上的护甲、地板上的包以及包上方架子上的那个白色小设备。
You will be taken to the M7 site and trailer, click Cor3.gg at the bottom, then “Wake Up”
你将被带到 M7 站点和拖车处，点击底部的 Cor3.gg，然后点击“Wake Up”

Back in the terminal this device is a new option on the bottom menu and needs decoding.
回到航站楼后，这个设备会成为底部菜单中的一个新选项，需要进行解码。

After waking up on a ship, you (the protagonist) pick up a hard drive and connect it into your terminal/tablet.
在飞船上醒来后，你（主角）拿起一个硬盘，并将其连接到你的终端/平板电脑中。

Fragment Timeline  碎片时间线

(More expansion on the timeline can be found on the Fragment timeline page)
（更多关于时间线的扩展内容可在“碎片时间线”页面查看）

Now we have decrypted/repaired the drive we can now access the file ‘EVID-CIS-MAIN-C2R1856.2’, double-click it to enter into a timeline with audio clips, video clips and some pictures. These are referred to as “FRAGMENTS” (Frags)
现在我们已经解密/修复了驱动器，可以访问文件“EVID-CIS-MAIN-C2R1856.2”，双击它即可进入一个包含音频片段、视频片段和一些图片的时间线。这些内容被称为“FRAGMENTS”（碎片，简称 Frags）。

There are a total of 20 discovered Fragments, and we need to progress through and unlock all 20.
目前已发现的碎片共有 20 个，我们需要逐步推进并解锁全部 20 个。

ACT 3 (Began April 12th, 5pm UTC)
第三幕（开始于 4 月 12 日 UTC 下午 5 点）

Daily Tasks:  每日任务：

It is important you complete your Daily Tasks, to get as many credits as possible. You need 4,500 credits at the end of Act 1 in order to progress to Act 2. We don’t know yet what else we may need credits for down the road. Credits are also earned through completion of other in-game loops, tasks and progression.
完成每日任务非常重要，这样可以获得尽可能多的 credits。你需要在第一幕结束时拥有 4,500 credits 才能推进到第二幕。我们尚不清楚后续还可能因其他用途需要 credits。完成其他游戏内循环、任务和进度也会获得 credits。

Note that the difficulty of the tasks increases on every 7th completion.
请注意，每完成 7 次任务后，任务难度都会提升。

Daily Task guide  每日任务指南

Daily tasks refresh daily at 00:00am GMT, if you miss it, you restart from day 1.
每日任务于格林尼治标准时间凌晨 00:00 刷新，若错过则从第 1 天重新开始。

 

Current Step: Act 3 - Fragile Deal
当前步骤：第三幕 - 脆弱的交易

现在达到声望 13 即可自动解锁 Pathfinder，将排名与你的实际长期进度挂钩。详见此处

SKIPPING TO ACT 3 ON REGISTRATION WILL NOT ALLOW ANY TASKS IN ACT 1/2 TO BE COMPLETED.
注册时跳过至第三幕将无法完成第一幕/第二幕中的任何任务。

Daily Tasks Guide:  每日任务指南：

Signal Decode  信号解码

Count out the number of pulses that you see. Morse is easier to decode.
数出你看到的脉冲数量。摩尔斯电码更容易解码。
The number will be a multiple of 4 or 5. You can close and reopen to get a different code.
该数字将是 4 或 5 的倍数。你可以关闭并重新打开以获取不同的代码。
Once you get to 20 characters, you will have to listen to the code to see which is which.
一旦达到 20 个字符，你就必须听代码来判断哪个是哪个。
We’ve seen lengths of 12,15,16,20, 25, 40 and 50 so far.
到目前为止，我们见过的长度有 12、15、16、20、25、40 和 50。
12, 16, 20 and 40 are Binary. 15, 25 and 50 are Morse.
12、16、20 和 40 是二进制。15、25 和 50 是摩尔斯电码。

A multiple of 5 is Morse. A multiple of 4 is Binary.
5 的倍数是摩尔斯电码。4 的倍数是二进制。

Otherwise, you simply match the S and L (Short and Long). Split the code into segmented chunks.
否则，你只需匹配 S 和 L（短和长）。将代码拆分成分段块。
Then match the chunks, Short and Long, to the segments you have.
然后将这些块（短块和长块）与你已有的分段进行匹配。
I have edited pictures here to show these chunks.
我在这里编辑了图片来展示这些块。

Binary is the same give or take, with 4 character segments.
二进制也大致相同，只是以 4 个字符为一段。

System Log Integrity
You need to pick the correct logs from the list, but the help telling you which logs to pick is on the second page!
系统日志完整性你需要从列表中选择正确的日志，但告诉你该选哪些日志的帮助信息在第二页！

The second log in this list is missing its /status. So it is a violation.
此列表中的第二条日志缺少其 /status。因此它属于违规。

The sixth one, seen in the image below, has its sector as “289”, which is outside the allowed range.
第六条（如下图所示）的扇区为“289”，超出了允许范围。
And the minutes in the time slot are “67”, which is also outside the range.
而该时间段中的分钟数为“67”，同样超出了范围。

The help at the top of this window tells you exactly what to look for.
此窗口顶部的帮助信息会确切告诉你需要查找什么。

[HH:MM:SS] <TYPE> /Sector=<1-256> /status=<OK|WARN|ERROR>

HH must be 00-23  HH 必须为 00-23
MM,SS must be 00-59  MM、SS 必须为 00-59
TYPE must be one of AUTH, TEMP-SYNC, SCAN, ROUTE-CHECK, RADIO-TEST, PING, SYNC
TYPE 必须是 AUTH、TEMP-SYNC、SCAN、ROUTE-CHECK、RADIO-TEST、PING、SYNC 之一
SECTOR must be present, and between 1 and 256.
SECTOR 必须存在，且介于 1 和 256 之间。
STATUS must be present, and one of OK, WARN, ERROR
STATUS 必须存在，且为 OK、WARN、ERROR 之一

Simply check off this list for the obvious violations, such as completely missing sections, then for finer details like numbers outside ranges and incorrect text.
先对照此列表检查明显的违规项，例如整段缺失，然后再检查更细的细节，例如数值超出范围和文本不正确。

After you confirm and rescan, the task is complete. It will try to run another loop, but you can just close it.
确认并重新扫描后，任务就完成了。它会尝试再运行一轮循环，但你直接关掉就行。

Loop 0 - Tutorial  第 0 轮 - 教程

00:00 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 00:00 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

Read Contract.pdf + Diary.pdf
阅读 Contract.pdf + Diary.pdf


Check the messenger with Aurana and reply to each message.
查看与 Aurana 的 messenger 并回复每条消息。


To open Documents folder, the password is your FREEL_### from the top right without the @
要打开 Documents 文件夹，密码是你右上角的 FREEL_###（去掉 @）

For example, mine would be FREEL_019BB847-FDC0
例如，我的密码会是 FREEL_019BB847-FDC0

Open each unlocked document, there is a unique minigame for each locked document, three in total. The minigame not documented here is just a ‘match the flash cards’ game
打开每个已解锁的文档，每个锁定文档都有一个独特的小游戏，总共三个。这里未记录的小游戏只是一个“匹配闪卡”游戏

Minigame 1 - The Interrogation.pdf
小游戏 1 - 审讯.pdf

Minigame 2 - Biofarm revision (meeting).pdf
小游戏 2 - 生物农场修订（会议）.pdf

Minigame 3 - Magnetism.pdf
小游戏 3 - 磁性.pdf

Neural breach is a sequence memory game, select a sector, then click scan. Alphanumeric tiles will flash in a specific sequence, when they finish flashing you just input the same sequence. Unlike when this guide was first written, you only need to remove any ‘LOCK’ tiles and complete the highlighted (unique to each player) tiles. Lock tiles are removed by completing adjacent tiles.
神经入侵是一款序列记忆游戏，选择一个扇区，然后点击扫描。字母数字方块会按特定序列闪烁，闪烁结束后，你只需输入相同的序列。与本指南最初编写时不同，你现在只需移除所有“LOCK”方块，并完成高亮方块（每位玩家各不相同）。移除锁定方块的方法是完成相邻方块。


Once the three locked files are unlocked. you will also get a file on the desktop called “Fromafriend.png” to signify completion of this step. View it if you’d like.
三个锁定文件解锁后，你还会在桌面上得到一个名为“Fromafriend.png”的文件，表示此步骤已完成。如果你愿意，可以查看它。

Return to messages with Aurana
返回与 Aurana 的消息


She will tell you to run the CLI Command “chmod 555 video”
她会让你运行 CLI 命令“chmod 555 video”


Reply to her and then click the terminal icon on the bottom of the screen ( >_ )
回复她，然后点击屏幕底部的终端图标（>_）


Type / paste in “chmod 555 video” (and hit enter or click send) and you can now access the video folder on your desktop
输入/粘贴“chmod 555 video”（然后按回车或点击发送），现在你就可以访问桌面上的视频文件夹了
Open it and watch the video, this is the end of the tutorial loop.
打开它并观看视频，这就是教程循环的终点。

Open the file and complete the minigame to unlock the video file.
打开文件并完成小游戏以解锁视频文件。

If you struggle with this minigame, we’d suggest manipulating the FREQ slider so that you leave it in a position with the highest visible % on the SYNC_RATE (green % number at the top) for that slider. Then do the same thing with the second AMP slider. This will allow you to simply slide the third slider until it autocompletes.
如果你在这个小游戏中遇到困难，我们建议调整 FREQ 滑块，将其停留在该滑块 SYNC_RATE 可见百分比最高（顶部的绿色百分比数字）的位置。然后对第二个 AMP 滑块做同样的操作。这样你就可以直接滑动第三个滑块，直到它自动完成。

Once unlocked, watch the video.
解锁后，观看视频。

This is the current end of the tutorial loop as of 10/3/2026
截至 2026 年 10 月 3 日，这是当前教程循环的终点

Following the video you will be placed on 1 of 4 loops below at random.
看完视频后，你将随机进入以下 4 个循环中的 1 个。
The order is different for all users.
每个用户的顺序都不同。

You MUST follow the steps of the path you are on before progressing another.
在进入下一步之前，你必须遵循当前所在路径的步骤。

循环 1 - 受损文件

20:40 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 20:40 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

First Completion by JustJayz - Discord
JustJayz 的首次通关 - Discord



You receive a message from Aurana, who says you’ve stumbled upon a file, which seems to be a report of sorts, but is very damaged. She thinks it's related to the experiments we’re investigating.
你收到 Aurana 发来的消息，她说你偶然发现了一个文件，看起来像是某种报告，但损坏得很严重。她认为这与我们正在调查的实验有关。

https://cdn.cor3.gg/corie/loops/1/damaged_document.jpg 

In the Document, you can find that the Investigation is carried out by Simon Webb.
在文档中，你可以发现这项调查是由 Simon Webb 进行的。

Go to the messenger / CORIE Database and search PERSON Simon Webb
前往 messenger / CORIE 数据库，搜索 PERSON Simon Webb

This will provide his ID (which is unique per person), which you can use to add him as a contact in the messenger.
这会提供他的 ID（每个人的 ID 都是唯一的），你可以用它把他添加为 messenger 中的联系人。

Once added, he will reach out asking what you want, and will eventually provide you with a website link to an old archive: https://viibot.corie/archives
添加后，他会主动联系你，询问你想要什么，并最终给你一个旧档案库的网站链接：https://viibot.corie/archives
A file will be added to your desktop, its name is a hint to the file you need on the archive. Note its starting letter to narrow down the correct result.
你的桌面上会出现一个文件，它的名称是档案库中你所需文件的提示。记下它的首字母，以缩小正确结果的范围。
It will be named a letter and then symbols. Either A or B.
它的命名方式是一个字母后跟符号。A 或 B。
E.G. - A%-!%^@!@  例如 - A%-!%^@!@
You need to find the classified document, the rating is in the top right. There are also three restricted docs.
你需要找到机密文件，评级在右上角。还有三份受限文档。


You only need the classified document, in it, view the image of the case, it has 104MHz hidden in it, and then tune the radio to the range 102-104MHz (this is hidden at the top of the case image) it will play morse code eventually on one of the freqs. Cycle through them. Morse will begin when the wind in the weather app is facing East.
你只需要机密文件，在其中查看案件图片，里面隐藏着 104MHz，然后将收音机调到 102-104MHz 范围（这隐藏在案件图片顶部），它最终会在其中一个频率上播放摩尔斯电码。循环切换这些频率。当天气应用中的风向朝东时，摩尔斯电码就会开始。

NOTE: DUE TO A BUG, NO AUDIO WILL PLAY ON THE RADIO. JUST HAVE THE RADIO OPEN ON 104MHz AND WATCH WEATHER, WHEN WIND IS EAST, THAT WILL TRIGGER THE NEXT STEP
注意：由于一个 bug，收音机不会播放音频。只需将收音机打开在 104MHz 并观察天气，当风向朝东时，就会触发下一步

The “Channel” will read d55pe18 on all correct freqs.
在所有正确的频率上，“Channel”都会显示 d55pe18。
https://radio-corie.cor3.gg/d55pe18
The Morse translates to "LOOK DEEPER INTO THE WEB CODE"
摩尔斯电码翻译为“LOOK DEEPER INTO THE WEB CODE”

If you close and reopen the classified report and look at the code in the browser, you will find a highlighted word hidden there “deeper”, click the word deeper to progress the discussion with Simon. This only shows AFTER hearing the morse, and refreshing the browser (navigating away or close/reopen)
如果你关闭并重新打开机密报告，并查看浏览器中的代码，你会发现那里隐藏着一个高亮单词“deeper”，点击单词 deeper 以推进与 Simon 的讨论。这只会在听到摩尔斯电码之后，并且刷新浏览器（离开页面或关闭/重新打开）后显示

循环 2 - 胡桃夹子站点

05:28 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 05:28 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

First Completion by Paralizard - Discord
Paralizard 的首次通关 - Discord

You will receive a message from “The Algorithm” which grants you access to the site
你会收到来自“The Algorithm”的消息，它会授予你访问该网站的权限

The NutCracker: https://forum.corie/main 
The NutCracker：https://forum.corie/main

  1. Go to the nutcracker forum, The top 3 posts are useful, but only the first and third need viewing. The first has a link in the first comment to archive.corie/main. Click that to unlock that page on the left of your browser
    前往 nutcracker 论坛，前 3 篇帖子都有用，但只需查看第一篇和第三篇。第一篇的第一条评论中有一个指向 archive.corie/main 的链接。点击它即可在浏览器左侧解锁该页面
  2. Go to the 3rd post, scroll down until you find the quote block that has a token at the bottom. copy that token.
    前往第 3 篇帖子，向下滚动，直到找到底部带有 token 的引用块。复制该 token。
  3. connect_site --token=tokenfromnutcracker in terminal. This information is given on the 2nd post, but not needed to be viewed. This both enables the Astrocrop site for 15 minutes, and adds it to your browser.
    在终端中运行 connect_site --token=tokenfromnutcracker。此信息在第 2 篇帖子中给出，但无需查看。这既会启用 Astrocrop 网站 15 分钟，也会将其添加到你的浏览器中。
    for example:    connect_site --token=qStpdTou6FxxuSbDgQ9Q
    例如：connect_site --token=qStpdTou6FxxuSbDgQ9Q



Be careful not to mix up 0 and O, and 1 and l.
注意不要混淆 0 和 O，以及 1 和 l。
There is an example of a 1 in the first image, second to last character
第一张图片中有一个数字 1 的示例，是倒数第二个字符

Be careful with the font if you are manually typing it out rather than copying it via F12/Inspector.
如果你是手动输入而不是通过 F12/检查器复制，请注意字体。

Note: After the 15 minute timer is up, you may lose connection with the actual game server, your token used in the command will likely be recycled into something different.
注意：15 分钟计时结束后，你可能会与实际游戏服务器断开连接，你在命令中使用的令牌很可能会被回收并替换为不同的内容。

  1. Go to the Astrocrop site, open files from the top right of the browser, by clicking the <> button, then the Files tab and download logs.txt
    前往 Astrocrop 网站，从浏览器右上角打开文件，点击<>按钮，然后点击 Files 标签页并下载 logs.txt

    This site may fail to load and show as RED on the left panel (Shows a 404 when clicked), still click the site, then click the <> icon and the files are there.
    该网站可能加载失败并在左侧面板显示为红色（点击时显示 404），仍然点击该网站，然后点击<>图标，文件就在那里。
    (if it doesn’t appear for you copy this link into CORIE)
    （如果它没有出现在你那里，请将此链接复制到 CORIE 中）
    https://archive.corie/main
  2. Sift through logs.txt to find the main offender ID. copy it, The line is WAF Block applied Id #####
    在 logs.txt 中筛选以找到主要违规者 ID。复制它，该行是 WAF Block applied Id #####
  1. Before the site shuts down, run block_id IDFROMLOGS In terminal e.g. block_id 123456
    在网站关闭之前，在终端中运行 block_id IDFROMLOGS，例如 block_id 123456
  2. You should get a message from "Unknown User"
    你会收到一条来自“未知用户”的消息
  3. Go through the conversation, afterwards, he will “hack” you. Prepare to press your number keys when the rows light up red to reset them. If 1 goes red, hit 1 on your keyboard before the timer runs out.
    浏览完对话后，他会“黑”你。准备好当各行亮起红灯时按下对应的数字键来重置它们。如果 1 变红，就在计时结束前按下键盘上的 1。
  4. This will then be followed by the standard Firewall Breach minigame.
    随后会进入标准的防火墙突破小游戏。
  5. You will get a new file on the desktop and more messages from Aurana and move to another loop.
    你会在桌面上收到一个新文件，以及来自 Aurana 的更多消息，然后进入下一个循环。

首次通关，作者 ImGoingSpace - Discord


You will receive a message from Aurana telling you to look at the sky lift incident and connect to an old usol cdc archive.
你会收到来自 Aurana 的消息，让你去查看天空升降机事件，并连接到一个旧的 usol cdc 档案库。
Open the browser.  打开浏览器。
Go to the Infinite Memory site and in the top right, click the <> icon, then you should see three files, SKY_ARC.txt and two images, view the images and open skyarc. It will add to the desktop.
前往 Infinite Memory 网站，在右上角点击 <> 图标，然后你应该会看到三个文件：SKY_ARC.txt 和两张图片。查看这些图片并打开 skyarc。它会添加到桌面。

From skyarc, there is a token in the file, copy this, it is unique per user.
在 skyarc 中，文件里有一个令牌，复制它，该令牌对每个用户都是唯一的。
In the terminal, enter connect usol cdc --password=YOURTOKEN
在终端中，输入 connect usol cdc --password=YOURTOKEN


4 of these files are valid, you need to guess which are correct.
这些文件中有 4 个是有效的，你需要猜出哪些是正确的。

Files that are incorrect will give an “Invalid command” error back, and consume a terminal attempt.
不正确的文件会返回“Invalid command”错误，并消耗一次终端尝试机会。

Example commands -   示例命令 -
scp A9_17B

scp SKL_O41

scp REC_A3

scp NT_FG22

scp OPS221X

scp R12_E

scp FRG_R1

scp AU_9D

scp S17K

scp BLK03

scp XM5_A

scp L041

scp RCP78

scp U_A1

scp BRK2

The list of files is different for each user. Keep trying until you get all 4.
每个用户的文件列表都不同。不断尝试，直到你找齐全部 4 个。
You will be given a new folder on the desktop called Reports
桌面上会给你一个新文件夹，名为 Reports
Look through the 5 files you can open, one is 5.0 Reputation locked.
查看你能打开的 5 个文件，其中一个是 5.0 Reputation 锁定的。
The other 4 files are the same but have different names for each user.
另外 4 个文件内容相同，但每个用户的文件名不同。
Take any full names you can find and in the corie advisor do a PERSON search for those names
找到任何你能找到的全名，然后在 corie advisor 中对这些姓名进行 PERSON 搜索
e.g.  例如


PERSON martin skypovski

You will find one profile that is complete with a 6 digit ID
你会找到一个完整的个人资料，其中包含一个 6 位 ID


Take that 6 digit ID and add them via the messenger “Add Contact”
获取那个 6 位 ID，然后通过通讯器“添加联系人”将其添加。

Talk through their dialogues and review the two files they send, then report back to Aurana to complete the loop.
通过他们的对话进行交流，并查看他们发送的两个文件，然后向 Aurana 汇报以完成循环。

BACK TO MAIN GUIDE  返回主指南

Or progress to next loop, if this was your last loop of Act 1, head to POST Investigations
或者进入下一个循环，如果这是你第一幕的最后一个循环，请前往 POST 调查

  1. LOOP 1: Damaged Document  循环 1：损坏的文件
  2. LOOP 2: Nutcracker  循环 2：胡桃夹子
  3. LOOP 3: Blueprints  循环 3：蓝图
  4. Post Investigations  POST 调查

Post Loop Investigation:  循环后调查：

24:50 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough
视频 24:50 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略

First Completion by TheColonel - Discord
TheColonel 的首次通关 - Discord

After completing all 4 loops, revisit the astrocrop archive and download all available files. One is rep locked to 4.0, which you now have, Sandman and sons.
完成全部 4 个循环后，重新访问 astrocrop 档案并下载所有可用文件。其中一个文件需要 4.0 声望解锁，你现在已经达到了，Sandman and sons。

We also have, in the reports folder, a file OPS_Archive which is 5.0 Rep locked.
在 reports 文件夹中，我们还有一个文件 OPS_Archive，需要 5.0 声望解锁。
You can run PERSON commands on the names in this file, of the Col and Majors
你可以对该文件中的上校和少校名字运行 PERSON 命令

PERSON Augustus Nordman
PERSON Frank Kirch

You do not need to do these at this time, but one name will be used later.
你现在不需要做这些，但稍后会用到其中一个名称。

Rep 5 - Trade & Shipment Database:
第 5 轮 - 贸易与货运数据库：

First Completion by TheColonel/ImGoingSpace
首次完成者：TheColonel/ImGoingSpace

Upon completing all 4 loops and talking with Aurana, Your diary on the desktop will update, open it, then you will receive a manifest file and folder, open this file and continue the discussion. Aurana will give you a link to a site telling you to run some CLI commands.
完成全部 4 个循环并与 Aurana 交谈后，你桌面上的日记会更新，打开它，然后你会收到一个清单文件和一个文件夹，打开这个文件并继续讨论。Aurana 会给你一个网站链接，告诉你运行一些 CLI 命令。

Run auth_probe trade_shipment in the terminal and you will see a list of codes.
在终端中运行 auth_probe trade_shipment，你会看到一列代码。
For each of these you need to run “auth_check” ID, this list is the same for everyone but in a different order. 3 of them will be valid, so once you have 3/3 you dont need to auth check the rest:
对于其中每一个，你都需要运行“auth_check” ID，这个列表对所有人都相同，但顺序不同。其中有 3 个是有效的，所以一旦你达到 3/3，就不需要再对其余的进行 auth check 了：

Copy and past these to not confuse L and I and 1.
复制粘贴这些内容，以免混淆 L、I 和 1。

Auth_check BxfBj
Auth_check sxMyG
Auth_check UGrwI
Auth_check WHpQB
Auth_check p6ny2

Auth_check FZlms
Auth_check 3G1y5
Auth_check 6A9Hb

Take your 3 segments and Auth_check 1-2-3, e.g. (it can be in any order, so there are six permutations)
取你的 3 个片段并执行 Auth_check 1-2-3，例如（顺序可以任意，因此共有六种排列）
auth_check WHpQB-6A9Hb-sxMyG


If the terminal response is “VALID 1/1” that is a failure.
如果终端响应是“VALID 1/1”，那就是失败。

Keep going until the response is just “VALID”, this will unlock the site.
继续操作，直到响应仅为“VALID”，这将解锁该网站。

A hint for this is in the “code” for the shipment site, hidden in a ROT13 cipher.
关于这一点的提示在货运网站的“code”中，隐藏在 ROT13 密码里。


We then need some ID’s. luckily the manifests document we just got is full of them!
然后我们需要一些 ID。幸运的是，我们刚拿到的清单文档里全是 ID！

我们感兴趣的是 Solaris 飞船的 ID，为方便起见列在这里

One of these IDs will give a different result, some may 404, if they do 404, use the back button in the virtual browser (NOT YOURS!) to save bandwidth. If the search keeps spinning, it is the same as a 404, search for the next ID.
这些 ID 中有一个会给出不同的结果，有些可能会返回 404；如果确实返回 404，请使用虚拟浏览器（不是你的浏览器！）中的后退按钮，以节省带宽。如果搜索一直转圈，那就等同于 404，请搜索下一个 ID。
The one we want will say REPNODE-M7 followed by a unique, per user, ID:
我们要找的那个会显示 REPNODE-M7，后面跟着一个每个用户唯一的 ID：

Search this ID in the registry and you'll see an image of a silo lid. Your Diary will now update.
在注册表中搜索这个 ID，你会看到一张筒仓盖的图片。你的日记现在会更新。
Read it and note the name to search up PERSON Seamus Malkob
阅读它，并记下要搜索的名字 PERSON Seamus Malkob

He will have a user ID to add. Converse with him.
他会有一个用户 ID 可供添加。与他交谈。

Once complete in the browser, go back to Astrocrop Archive and on the files tab, download SBS4 and Demeter.
在浏览器中完成后，回到 Astrocrop Archive，在文件选项卡中下载 SBS4 和 Demeter。



A folder is added to the desktop that is PW Protected, the password is in the manifests file.
桌面上会添加一个受密码保护的文件夹，密码在清单文件中。

 It is on the line:
它在以下行中：
“Sealed fluid modules (BIOHAZARD WARNING), SBS4-######”
“密封流体模块（生物危害警告），SBS4-######”
The password is the SBS4-##### At the end of this line. the whole thing, including SBS4.
密码是这一行末尾的 SBS4-#####。是整个内容，包括 SBS4。


Open both files and the diary updates again. Read it once more. Aurana will message you and send over 5 IDs to add as a contact. The third ID will add a contact “V3 News”.
打开这两个文件，日记会再次更新。再读一遍。Aurana 会给你发消息，并发送 5 个 ID 让你添加为联系人。第三个 ID 会添加一个联系人“V3 News”。

The Diary updates once more, read it. It states to look back through files for names relating to Mars, there are two
日记会再次更新，读一下。里面说要在文件中查找与 Mars 相关的名字，有两个

PERSON Thomas Albertson
人物 Thomas Albertson
His Profile has an ID on the top right now, Add him. And talk through his dialogue to be told about a prototype called “Gobbler”
现在他的个人资料右上角有一个 ID，添加他。并看完他的对话，会被告知一个名为“Gobbler”的原型。
Then search for FILE Gobbler to see a new image to gain +0.1 rep.
然后搜索 FILE Gobbler 查看新图像，以获得 +0.1 声望。

From the OPS_Archive.txt file, PERSON Augustus Nordman
从 OPS_Archive.txt 文件中，人物 Augustus Nordman

Talk through his dialog and you will be messaged by Aurana again.
看完他的对话，Aurana 会再次给你发消息。
She will give you a password to use the updater at the bottom toolbar.
她会给你一个密码，用于底部工具栏中的更新器。

代表 6 - 更新 Corie：

Once updated you will see new items on the taskbar you cannot use yet.

You’ll need to save up 4,500CR 3,500CR to “move” to REPNODE-M7.

First Completion by Para & GigaMonkeh - Discord
首次完成：Para 与 GigaMonkeh - Discord

After clicking “Depart” on the M7 ship, you will get a message from Aurana telling you to collect your things and you’ll go back outside the terminal. Click the Armor on the left table, the bag on the floor and on the shelf above the bag, the small white device.
在 M7 飞船上点击“出发”后，你会收到 Aurana 的消息，让你收拾好东西，然后你会回到终端外面。点击左侧桌子上的护甲、地板上的包以及包上方架子上的那个白色小设备。
You will be taken to the M7 site and trailer, click Cor3.gg at the bottom, then “Wake Up”
你将被带到 M7 站点和拖车处，点击底部的 Cor3.gg，然后点击“Wake Up”

Back in the terminal this device is a new option on the bottom menu and needs decoding.

Review the device, rotate the model for info, then insert the disk. Look at all its “DEV:INFO” details printed in the log to find a mention of the corietech.corie website. You need to manually type this URL in.
查看设备，旋转模型以获取信息，然后插入磁盘。查看日志中打印的所有“DEV:INFO”详细信息，找到对 corietech.corie 网站的提及。你需要手动输入此 URL。

Manually browse in CORIE browser to:

https://coretech.corie/

You need to manually head over to:

https://coretech.corie/model-MR-7-Media-Reader-78x/SN-A2089-99D-3K201


Then browse to: https://coretech.corie/products/consumer/other-components 
然后浏览至：https://coretech.corie/products/consumer/other-components

At the top, Product Solutions > Computing & System components > Additional PC & Server Components.
在顶部，依次选择 Product Solutions > Computing & System components > Additional PC & Server Components。
Download the v.1.16.05 firmware update for CST-HR23 Rev.B Controller.
下载 CST-HR23 Rev.B 控制器的 v.1.16.05 固件更新。

You will now have various files downloaded and applications ready to start decoding the harddrive which is our next step
现在你将下载各种文件并准备好应用程序，开始解码硬盘，这是我们的下一步

Decoding the Drive:
解码硬盘：

Open the MR-7 Media Reader 78X application in your task part, and click on the hard drive to load it. This will then open a new mini-game. The manual for the mini-game is on your desktop in the file “manual.txt”, it’s an extensive document, but the steps do not appear to be unique for everyone can just be followed as per below.
在你的任务栏中打开 MR-7 Media Reader 78X 应用程序，然后点击硬盘将其加载。随后会打开一个新的小游戏。小游戏的说明书在你的桌面上，文件名为“manual.txt”，它是一份内容详尽的文档，但其中的步骤似乎并非对每个人都独一无二，只需按以下步骤操作即可。

Select FIX and a mini-game will pop up. In this mini-game you have 3 attempts through a 10-timer, however if you fail it’ll just take you back to the beginning, there fortunately is no cooldown or timegates.
选择 FIX，会弹出一个小游戏。在这个小游戏中，你有 3 次尝试机会，限时 10 秒，不过如果失败，只会把你带回起点，幸运的是没有冷却时间或时间限制。

There are multiple steps to the mini-game, each requiring you to change various settings to advance to the next step.
这个小游戏有多个步骤，每一步都需要你更改各种设置才能进入下一步。

E-27 Steps:
E-27 步骤：

FREQ B
频率 B

Press SERVICE button
按下 SERVICE 按钮

FREQ A
频率 A

FILTER ON
滤波器开启

Enter DIGITS: 555
输入数字：555

E-41 Steps:
E-41 步骤：

FILTER OFF
滤波器关闭

POWER OFF
电源关闭

Enter DIGITS: 99235
输入数字：99235

POWER ON
电源开启

Enter CALIBRATION mode,
进入校准模式，

Set all three:
将三项全部设置：

FILTER: ON
滤波器：开启

SHIELD: ON
屏蔽：开启

FREQ: A
频率：A

POWER OFF
关闭电源

Hold SERVICE button (for around 5 seconds, use the time left timer to help)
按住 SERVICE 按钮（约 5 秒，可借助剩余时间计时器）

POWER ON
开启电源

If done successfully, device state will now be in CALIBRATION mode
如果操作成功，设备状态现在将处于校准模式

The status code will now cycle through the below 4 key words in a random order, enter the corresponding codes below;
状态代码现在将按随机顺序循环显示以下 4 个关键词，请在下方输入对应的代码；

END - type 7
END - 输入 7

ERROR - type 21
ERROR - 输入 21

LEAD - type 44
LEAD - 输入 44

FALSE - type 14
FALSE - 输入 14

E-52 Resolution (60% SYNC)
E-52 解决方法（60% 同步）

FILTER: OFF
过滤器：关闭

SHIELD: OFF
屏蔽：关闭

FREQ: C
频率：C

Enter DIGITS: 2165
输入数字：2165

SYNC should now be at 80% with status “Service Required”.
同步率现在应为 80%，状态为“需要维修”。

Re-Enter CALIBRATION mode,
重新进入校准模式，

Set all three:
将以下三项全部设置：

FILTER: ON
滤波器：开启

SHIELD: ON
屏蔽：开启

FREQ: A
频率：A

POWER OFF
关机

Hold SERVICE button (for around 5 seconds, use the time left timer to help)
按住 SERVICE 按钮（约 5 秒，可借助剩余时间计时器）

POWER ON
开机

Device state should be now CALIBRATION with current SYNC at 80%.
设备状态现在应为 CALIBRATION，当前 SYNC 为 80%。

The status code will now cycle through the below 2 key words in a random order, enter the corresponding codes below;
状态代码现在将按随机顺序循环显示以下 2 个关键词，请在下方输入对应的代码；

TOOL = 27

LOOP = 6

SYNC should now be at 100%, click READ to finish the mini-game
SYNC 现在应该达到 100%，点击 READ 完成小游戏

Upon finishing the above, return back to the EVID-CIS-MAIN-C2R1856.2 file in the reader and you should now have a total of 4 fragments unlocked!
完成上述操作后，返回阅读器中的 EVID-CIS-MAIN-C2R1856.2 文件，你现在应该总共解锁了 4 个碎片！

Stage 2: 5th and 6th Fragments, Updating Reader Firmware
第 2 阶段：第 5 和第 6 个碎片，更新阅读器固件

06:02 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough - Act 2
视频 06:02 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略 - 第 2 幕
First solved by unnamed user from Mr.Souers chat
由 Mr.Souers 聊天室的一位匿名用户首次解出


Firmware Update Procedure:
固件更新步骤：

Open Terminal and run:  update reader <firmware_executable> <authorization_key>
打开终端并运行：update reader <firmware_executable> <authorization_key>

We need to build the authorisation key from the folder. Everyone has a UNIQUE auth key, so do not use someone else's!
我们需要从文件夹中构建授权密钥。每个人的授权密钥都是唯一的，所以不要使用别人的！

Next we need to extract your unique 12 letter character segments from this file.
接下来，我们需要从这个文件中提取你唯一的 12 个字母字符段。

From the manual we get told
手册中告诉我们

"The key is assembled by extracting 4 characters from line 2, 4 characters from line 4, 2 characters from line 7, and 2 characters from line 9 of the block governed by the 10-character segment of the block schema"
“密钥的组装方式是：从由区块模式的 10 字符段所管辖的区块中，提取第 2 行的 4 个字符、第 4 行的 4 个字符、第 7 行的 2 个字符和第 9 行的 2 个字符”

An example license key broken by dashes and sorted into lines:
一个示例许可证密钥，用短横线分隔并分行排列：

KCX52Q9QB2-4E1G-XUCA-WJ7U-D5BP3C1H5CMJMYCEY3I7P49BUK84KP9CMD337ETCIFB5MP1MPBYAWUAAMXZO1OVXFYUVBVXLFHS47U7E9VQYE52DRQH7DCPTSS47-3TIHZKNL48YLDA9DM3RE5T5ICLCEGI-NW-AK-F1-4F-JL

Line 1:  KCX52Q9QB2 = 10 chars - "the 10-character segment"
第 1 行：KCX52Q9QB2 = 10 个字符 - “10 字符段”

Line 2:  4E1G (4 chars)
第 2 行：4E1G（4 个字符）

Line 3:  XUCA (4 chars)
第 3 行： XUCA（4 个字符）

Line 4:  WJ7U (4 chars)
第 4 行：WJ7U（4 个字符）

Line 5:  D5BP3C1H5C...  (100 chars - the long segment)
第 5 行： D5BP3C1H5C... （100 个字符——长片段）

The intended solution to this puzzle is very manually complex, and detailed in the second hint given, below.
这个谜题的预期解法非常依赖手工操作，且十分复杂，详见下方给出的第二条提示。
Within the 3 “chunks”, denoted by the Capital section, we need to try to offset each letter with each number.
在由大写部分标出的 3 个“块”中，我们需要尝试将每个字母与每个数字进行偏移。
So all 5 numbers, in both directions, for all 5 letters.
所以全部 5 个数字，双向都要，对应全部 5 个字母。
The hint tells us we cannot go over 26 (ergo, below 0) which excludes any negative offsets for “A” and any positive from “Z”. This helps lower the possible combinations slightly.

Here is an example for the first five letters.

“In the age of great discoveries of our former home, people sought their way by lifting their gaze to the night sky. Long before the obsessive desire to reach the stars themselves was born, they learned how to read their arrangement.
“在我们昔日家园的伟大发现时代，人们通过仰望夜空来寻找方向。早在那种想要抵达星辰本身的执念诞生之前，他们就已经学会了如何解读星辰的排列。

Guided by the light of celestial bodies, they traveled across water and land, weaving an invisible network of directions and numbers. Thus, order emerged where there had once been only darkness.
在天体之光的指引下，他们穿越水域与陆地，编织出一张由方向与数字构成的无形网络。于是，秩序在曾经只有黑暗的地方浮现出来。

Yet not every light that flickers above belongs to the heavens. Among them is one that merely pretends to be a star - it occupies a place, but has no name; it is visible to the eye, yet absent from the records.
然而，并非所有在天上闪烁的光都属于苍穹。其中有一颗只是假装成星星——它占据着一个位置，却没有名字；肉眼可见，却不见于记载。

Point it out to us.”
指给我们看。”

LordCommander on discord got this, i’m dropping their writeup below as we were close, but clearly not close enough.
Discord 上的 LordCommander 得到了这个，我把他们的说明放在下面，因为我们当时已经很接近了，但显然还不够接近。

  • I spent some time digging into this and I think I found a working alternative approach to the problem. I used the same star map generation service that was used to create the original image, and generated a similar sky map, aligning it so that Betelgeuse is centered, but this time with a coordinate grid enabled. I set the grid value to 1, since the service doesn’t allow anything smaller. Next, I took the image we were given in the quest, converted it to SVG, removed the black background, and recolored all white stars into red dots. Then I overlaid this on top of the generated star map with the coordinate grid. The number of stars didn’t match perfectly — they have more stars, I had fewer. Most likely different generation settings were used. That part doesn’t really matter. What does matter is that after overlaying, three types of points appeared: White - real stars White + red - overlaps Pure red And those pure red dots are exactly what exists on their star map but does not exist in real sky data. There is only one such point. I know we already identified this fake star earlier, but I needed to push the coordinates to maximum possible precision, and the coordinate grid made this much easier than trying to draw one manually. This service has a really useful feature: when you click any point on the map, it shows the exact RA/DEC coordinates of where you clicked.
    我花了一些时间深入研究这个问题，我想我找到了一个可行的替代方案。我使用了当初生成原始图像时所用的同一个星图生成服务，生成了一张类似的星空图，并调整对齐使参宿四位于中心，但这次启用了坐标网格。我把网格值设为 1，因为该服务不支持更小的值。接下来，我把任务中提供给我们的图像转换为 SVG，移除黑色背景，并将所有白色恒星重新着色为红点。然后，我把这张图叠加到带坐标网格的生成星图之上。恒星数量并不完全吻合——他们的恒星更多，我的更少。很可能是使用了不同的生成设置。那部分并不重要。重要的是，叠加之后出现了三类点：白色——真实恒星；白色+红色——重叠部分；纯红色。而那些纯红色的点，正是存在于他们的星图上、但不存在于真实天空数据中的东西。这样的点只有一个。我知道我们之前已经识别出了这颗假星，但我需要把坐标推到尽可能高的精度，而坐标网格让这件事比手动绘制网格容易得多。这个服务有一个非常实用的功能：当你点击地图上的任意一点时，它会显示你所点击位置的精确赤经/赤纬坐标。
  •  To increase accuracy, I did something a bit cursed but effective: at work, I asked our sysadmin for an old monitor with huge pixels, so the physical size of each pixel would be as large as possible. Then I literally clicked pixel by pixel, cross-referencing with the overlay image, and wrote down the coordinates for each one. Honestly, if I had printed the image on semi-transparent paper at the same scale and laid it over the monitor, it would’ve been even easier — since the system doesn’t mark which pixels you’ve already clicked. Using this method, I confirmed that the fake star occupies a 7×7 pixel area. I recorded the coordinates of all intersecting pixels, and separately identified the exact center pixel. After that, it was straightforward: click the center pixel → read the coordinates → write them down. That value ended up being the answer.
    为了提高准确度，我做了一件有点邪门但很有效的事：上班时，我向系统管理员要了一台像素巨大的旧显示器，让每个像素的物理尺寸尽可能大。然后我真的一个像素一个像素地点，对照叠加图逐一核对，并把每个像素的坐标记下来。说实话，如果我把图像按相同比例打印在半透明纸上，再盖到显示器上，那还会更简单——因为系统不会标记哪些像素已经点过了。用这个方法，我确认那颗假星占据了一个 7×7 像素的区域。我记录下所有相交像素的坐标，并单独确定了正中心像素。之后就很直接了：点击中心像素 → 读取坐标 → 记下来。那个值最终就是答案。

我的人发现了一把改装过的等离子切割器，能射到 30 米远，老板！这太疯狂了！嗯，我是说，当然开火后它会爆炸……但你懂我意思！你能帮帮我们吗？

Also, we have followed their leader - that “Antouan” dude. He’s creepy as fuck, and everyone is scared of him, but what we heard is that his own man are saying he changed recently, became obsessed with something and even more violent AND he keeps visiting that “Velluto” place, you know, with girls …
还有，我们跟了他们的头目——那个叫“Antouan”的家伙。他他妈瘆人得很，所有人都怕他，但我们听说他自己的人都说他最近变了，变得对什么东西着了魔，而且更加暴力，还老是去那个“Velluto”的地方，你知道的，有姑娘的那种……

You know who that belongs to, right ? Guys think it's somehow connected to the recent heist. Like someone in there talked to the guy. Where else could he get that information on time and place?
你知道那地方是谁的吧？大伙觉得这事跟最近那起抢劫案有点关系。像是里面有人跟那家伙通了气。不然他还能从哪儿及时搞到时间和地点的情报？

We took a liberty to ask the usual guy for help and he was able to find their internal site address, “backroom.local” but it's encrypted and we could not get a password. Need someone with skills, you know …
我们擅自找了一直合作的那家伙帮忙，他找到了他们的内部网站地址“backroom.local”，但它是加密的，我们搞不到密码。得找个有本事的人来，你懂的……

One more thing, Boss. With all due respect, we think that those Voktr guys are not the ones calling the shots. They are dumb. Like no way they did all that on their own.
还有一件事，老大。恕我直言，我们觉得那些 Voktr 的家伙不是说了算的人。他们蠢得很。绝不可能全靠他们自己干出那些事。

Group 1 — double encryption in each case + triple encryption. The key is in the radio

gsh:whyjrjkbsj

Found on frequency 72 Mhz
在 72 MHz 频率上发现

- Substituting 7 and 2 Using A=0, B=1, C=2…. Z=25, we get “HC”
- 使用 A=0、B=1、C=2……Z=25 替换 7 和 2，我们得到“HC”

- Using “HC” as the key to vigenere “gsh:whyjrjkbsj” gives “zqa:uawcpciuqc”
- 使用“HC”作为维吉尼亚密码“gsh:whyjrjkbsj”的密钥，得到“zqa:uawcpciuqc”

- Vigenering again with the key “PMC” gives “key:foundation”
- 再次使用密钥“PMC”进行维吉尼亚加密，得到“key:foundation”

vjc:duhawmfhqt

Found on frequency 116 MHz
在频率 116 MHz 上发现

- Substituting 1 1 6 Using A=0, B=1, C=2…. Z=25, we get “BBG”
- 使用 A=0、B=1、C=2……Z=25 替换 1 1 6，我们得到“BBG”

- Using “BBG” as the key to vigenere “vjc:duhawmfhqt” gives “uiw:ctbzvgegks”
- 使用“BBG”作为维吉尼亚密码“vjc:duhawmfhqt”的密钥，得到“uiw:ctbzvgegks”

- Vigenering again with the key “KEYCONFIDENCE” gives “key:afoundatio”
- 再次使用密钥“KEYCONFIDENCE”进行维吉尼亚加密，得到“key:afoundatio”

aynkqfniwig

Found on frequency 137 MHz
在频率 137 MHz 上发现

- Substituting 1 3 7 Using A=0, B=1, C=2…. Z=25, we get “BDH”
- 用 A=0，B=1，C=2……Z=25 替换 1 3 7，得到“BDH”

- Using “BDH” as the key to vigenere “aynkqfniwig” gives zvgjnymfphd
- 使用“BDH”作为密钥对“aynkqfniwig”进行维吉尼亚加密，得到 zvgjnymfphd

- Vigenering again with the key “KEYONFIDENC” gives “privateclub”
- 再次使用密钥“KEYONFIDENC”进行维吉尼亚加密，得到“privateclub”

14:51 in video - Cor3.gg ARG Walkthrough - Act 2
视频 14:51 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略 - 第二幕
First solved by Dub/Nitro/LordCommander in discord (this one sucked it was a good group effort with low morale)
最初由 Discord 上的 Dub/Nitro/LordCommander 解出（这个很糟糕，是一次士气低落的良好团队合作）

Unknown will guide you to a website to use in the browser:
Unknown 会引导你在浏览器中访问一个网站：

https://Private-Club.PMC.corie

However, to access the website, you need to stabilize the route first using this command in the terminal: (can be found in the messages with Unknown, each user's token is different!)
不过，要访问该网站，你需要先在终端中使用以下命令稳定路由：（可在与 Unknown 的消息中找到，每个用户的令牌都不同！）

route stabilize --target=Private-Club.PMC.corie --token=YOURTOKENHERE

Once on the website, press the join button on the homepage.
进入网站后，按首页上的加入按钮。

Insert your name and FREEL ID (without the @), fill in the rest of the fields to your liking and apply. Then also apply in the notification banner that pops up in the bottom left of your screen.
填写你的姓名和 FREEL ID（不带 @），其余字段按你的喜好填写并提交申请。然后还要在屏幕左下角弹出的通知横幅中提交申请。

Once applied open the database and query:
申请后，打开数据库并查询：

PERSON Suzanna Flanders

Grab her FREE ID (6 digits) and add her as a friend and go through her dialogue. She will lead you to a new website and tell you that her daughter had a pseudonym JayJay
获取她的 FREE ID（6 位数字），将她添加为好友并浏览她的对话。她会引导你前往一个新网站，并告诉你她的女儿曾使用化名 JayJay

https://grvforum.corie 

if this site doesn’t load, don’t worry, its not needed. Skip to the PERSON command below.
如果这个网站加载不出来，别担心，不需要它。跳到下面的 PERSON 命令。

You will also have a folder called Janes_Notes with a txt file inside. Inside the file, it is mentioned that a password is Rebe10ne
你还会有一个名为 Janes_Notes 的文件夹，里面有一个 txt 文件。文件里提到密码是 Rebe10ne

On the graver website, by using the process of elimination on all the usernames there in the forums. We managed to find the correct username:
在 graver 网站上，通过对论坛中所有用户名进行排除法，我们成功找到了正确的用户名：

To login:
登录方式：
Username: a11_ta1k
用户名：a11_ta1k

PW: Rebe10ne
密码：Rebe10ne

From the forum we find out there is a Mr Bailey and a Daniel, and by process of elimination we found that this is the same person. Searching them up using the person (name) gives us his FREEL ID and we can add him.
从论坛中我们发现有一个叫 Mr Bailey 的人和一个叫 Daniel 的人，通过排除法我们发现这是同一个人。使用 person（姓名）搜索他们，可以得到他的 FREEL ID，然后我们就可以添加他。

PERSON Daniel Bailey

This step seems to get stuck for some people. Periodically CTRL+F5 and it should eventually work. He tells us to use the terminal to
这一步对某些人来说似乎会卡住。定期按 CTRL+F5，最终应该就能成功。他让我们用终端来

connect hwells.home --password=Em0Ch3m
连接 hwells.home --password=Em0Ch3m

In the terminal there are a lot of files/folders, none of which can be currently opened as we need to bypass the firewall using the command
终端里有很多文件/文件夹，目前都无法打开，因为我们需要用以下命令绕过防火墙

firewall.config

This will lead you to a maze minigame where you need to use the arrow keys to get to the bottom right corner of the maze. Once complete, you can access all the other files. All files with their content can be found on https://github.com/3ncy/cor3/blob/main/Terminal/hwells.home.md. Important ones are:
这会带你进入一个迷宫小游戏，你需要使用方向键到达迷宫的右下角。完成后，你就可以访问所有其他文件。所有文件及其内容都可以在 https://github.com/3ncy/cor3/blob/main/Terminal/hwells.home.md 找到。重要的文件有：
access_list.txt
codes_of_conduct.txt

add gravver_node_5,gravver_node_9
添加 gravver_node_5,gravver_node_9

Once done, message Daniel saying that it's complete, continue the dialogue and he will give you the login and password for the privateclub pmc site.
完成后，给 Daniel 发消息说已经完成，继续对话，他会给你 privateclub pmc 网站的登录名和密码。

Login: ops.review_4415
登录名：ops.review_4415

PW: V4ultR0tate-77
密码：V4ultR0tate-77

Afterwards on terminal use:
之后在终端使用：

connect PMC_signals --password=trd078bp


PLEASE NOTE: This step was simplified after it was figured out. Just skip to the first GRANT ROLE command, then everything after.
请注意：这一步在弄清楚之后已被简化。直接跳到第一条 GRANT ROLE 命令，然后执行之后的所有内容。

By previously connecting to privateclubID441538964employeesinfo in Stage 6 and using the command:
通过在阶段 6 中先前连接到 privateclubID441538964employeesinfo 并使用以下命令：
register node --id=privateclubID441538964employeesinfo --user=ops.review_4415

you will see a success message letting you know that the archive has been updated along with Base64 encoded text  Z3JhbnQgcm9sZSA= translating to “grant role”
你会看到一条成功消息，告知你归档已更新，同时附带 Base64 编码文本 Z3JhbnQgcm9sZSA=，其含义为“grant role”

The ‘employeesinfo’ report in the archive on https://private-club.pmc.corie will then be available for viewing.
随后，https://private-club.pmc.corie 上归档中的“employeesinfo”报告将可供查看。

Group 1 Hint solving:

Group 1 — double encryption in each case + triple encryption. The key is in the radio

fdvhnvdxnlg

gewioweynmg

----------------------

gsh:whyjrjkbsj

Found on frequency 72 Mhz
在 72 MHz 频率上发现

- Substituting 7 and 2 Using A=0, B=1, C=2…. Z=25, we get “HC”
- 使用 A=0、B=1、C=2……Z=25 替换 7 和 2，得到“HC”

- Using “HC” as the key to vigenere “gsh:whyjrjkbsj” gives “zqa:uawcpciuqc”
- 使用“HC”作为密钥对“gsh:whyjrjkbsj”进行维吉尼亚解密，得到“zqa:uawcpciuqc”

- Vigenering again with the key “PMC” gives “key:foundation”
- 再次使用密钥“PMC”进行维吉尼亚解密，得到“key:foundation”

vjc:duhawmfhqt

Found on frequency 116 MHz
在 116 MHz 频率上发现

- Substituting 1 1 6 Using A=0, B=1, C=2…. Z=25, we get “BBG”
- 使用 A=0、B=1、C=2……Z=25 替换 1 1 6，得到“BBG”

- Using “BBG” as the key to vigenere “vjc:duhawmfhqt” gives “uiw:ctbzvgegks”
- 使用“BBG”作为密钥对“vjc:duhawmfhqt”进行维吉尼亚解密，得到“uiw:ctbzvgegks”

- Vigenering again with the key “KEYCONFIDENCE” gives “key:afoundatio”
- 再次使用密钥“KEYCONFIDENCE”进行维吉尼亚解密，得到“key:afoundatio”

aynkqfniwig

Found on frequency 137 MHz
在频率 137 MHz 上发现

- Substituting 1 3 7 Using A=0, B=1, C=2…. Z=25, we get “BDH”
- 用 A=0、B=1、C=2……Z=25 替换 1 3 7，得到“BDH”

- Using “BDH” as the key to vigenere “aynkqfniwig” gives zvgjnymfphd
- 使用“BDH”作为密钥对“aynkqfniwig”进行维吉尼亚加密，得到 zvgjnymfphd

- Vigenering again with the key “KEYONFIDENC” gives “privateclub”
- 再次使用密钥“KEYONFIDENC”进行维吉尼亚加密，得到“privateclub”

Note: Below was updated by nitr0m4n. The y=x2+1 - 10 equation fits better in relation to figuring out the numbers for the code above and translating them from 3597 -> 6798
注意：以下内容由 nitr0m4n 更新。y=x2+1 - 10 这个方程在推算上述代码的数字并将其从 3597 转换为 6798 方面更合适

y = (x2 + 1) - 10 interpreted as y = (2*x + 1) - 10
y = (x2 + 1) - 10 解释为 y = (2*x + 1) - 10

x=1 → y=(2*1+1) - 10 | y = -7

x=2 → y=(2*2+1) - 10 | y = -5

x=3 → y=(2*3+1) - 10 | y = -3

x=4 → y=(2*4+1) - 10 | y = -1

x=5 → y=(2*5+1) - 10 | y = 1

x=6 → y=(2*6+1) - 10 | y = 3

x=7 → y=(2*7+1) - 10 | y = 5

x=8 → y=(2*8+1) - 10 | y = 7

x=9 → y=(2*9+1) - 10 | y = 9

3597 -> Formula -> 6798
3597 -> 公式 -> 6798

Recombine to become jzizhpPUPIABROGK6798

之后你需要再次联系 Unknown（Palimpsest）。

This minigame is an instance of a puzzle called “King and thousand barrels of wine”/”Poisoned wine bottle” — you have to find one number from the range between 1 and 1000.
这个小游戏是“国王与一千桶酒”/“毒酒瓶”谜题的一个实例——你必须从 1 到 1000 的范围内找出一个数字。

Many guides can be found on the internet by googling the name of the puzzle, for example a short summary and guide on https://brainstellar.com/puzzles/easy/31, or a significantly longer explanation on https://medium.com/i-math/a-king-1000-bottles-of-wine-10-prisoners-and-a-drop-of-poison-2dd1959a8dd2.
在互联网上搜索谜题名称即可找到许多攻略，例如 https://brainstellar.com/puzzles/easy/31 上的简短总结和攻略，或 https://medium.com/i-math/a-king-1000-bottles-of-wine-10-prisoners-and-a-drop-of-poison-2dd1959a8dd2 上详细得多的解释。

Alternatively, this variation of the puzzle also allows a very simple bruteforce solution, by allowing you to slowly narrow down the range: Fill out the page with numbers for your first run. Record the range with Status “ON” in your notes.
另外，这个谜题的变体也允许一种非常简单的暴力破解解法，让你可以慢慢缩小范围：第一次运行时，在页面中填入数字。在笔记中记录状态为“ON”的范围。

Close the minigame, wait out your 60 minute timer, re-open the mini-game and enter into the ten testers (we’re using the 701-800 example here): 701-710, 711-720, 721-730, 731-740, 741-750, 751-760, 761-770, 771-780, 781-790, and 791-800 then run the minigame. The resulting ‘ON’ number series (let’s pick 741-750 as ON) allows you to simply enter the File=741, File=742, … ,File=750 into your terminal to get the final correct number.
关闭小游戏，等待 60 分钟计时结束，重新打开小游戏，并在十个测试器中输入（这里以 701-800 为例）：701-710、711-720、721-730、731-740、741-750、751-760、761-770、771-780、781-790 和 791-800，然后运行小游戏。得到的“ON”数字序列（假设 741-750 为 ON）让你可以简单地在终端中输入 File=741、File=742、……、File=750，从而得到最终正确的数字。

In the terminal enter:
在终端中输入：

File=<your_number>
Example: File=375
示例：File=375

视频 36:45 处 - Cor3.gg ARG 攻略 - 第二幕
First solved by a bit of everyone tbh in discord
说实话，这是 Discord 里大家共同解出来的

You can now leave the ship and move to Act 3. DO NOT LEAVE UNTIL COMPLETION OF STAGE 9
你现在可以离开飞船并进入第三幕。在完成第 9 阶段之前不要离开

如果你离开飞船，第 9 阶段将无法完成。

Use the command
使用命令

connect cleaner_bot_4_2 --password=12345

Then
然后

cb_system_info

You will be told to type
系统会提示你输入

/cb_set operating protocol

This starts the first minigame where you need to guess the correct permutations of 4 different keys where you’re given 3 values for each key. Please note, the answer is different every time you open the command!
这会启动第一个小游戏，你需要猜出 4 个不同按键的正确排列，每个按键会给出 3 个值。请注意，每次打开该命令时答案都会不同！


The response is case sensitive. Some examples using the 3 sets of options;
响应区分大小写。以下是使用这 3 组选项的一些示例；

v1.0 GET LTE AES
v1.1 GET LTE AES
v1.0 PUT LTE AES

v1.0 GET Fiber AES

v1.0 GET LTE RSA

change one item at a time, with three options, you can eliminate a whole row in two commands.
一次只改一项，共有三个选项，用两条命令就能排除整整一行。

You can also change all of the entries and hope you get a 4/4 mismatch, to eliminate those 4. But that's less consistent.
你也可以把所有条目都改一遍，指望得到 4/4 的不匹配，从而排除这 4 项。但这样的一致性较差。

Run the above list of commands, slowly 1 by one, if the number of mismatches goes DOWN, then keep that new value. If it stays the same, then you know both values tried are wrong, so the third is the answer.
逐条慢慢运行上面的命令列表，如果不匹配的数量下降了，就保留那个新值。如果保持不变，就说明尝试的两个值都是错的，因此第三个就是答案。

I.e.
即：

v1.0 GET LTE AES - 4 Wrong
v1.0 GET LTE AES - 4 项错误
v1.1 GET LTE AES - 3 Wrong
v1.1 GET LTE AES - 3 项错误

(this means v1.1 is correct, keep it!)
（这意味着 v1.1 是正确的，保留它！）

v1.0 GET LTE AES - 4 Wrong
v1.0 GET LTE AES - 4 错误
v1.1 PUT LTE AES- 4 Wrong
v1.1 PUT LTE AES- 4 错误

(this means both GET and PUT are wrong. So the 2nd answer is POST.)
（这意味着 GET 和 PUT 都是错误的。所以第二个答案是 POST。）

Once you have complete the minigame run the command
完成小游戏后，运行命令

cb_rig_status

Then
然后

cb_task_list

Then
然后

/cb_remove tasks

Finally, run
最后，运行

cb_direct_control

  • To replay the minigame, just use this command again.
    要重玩这个小游戏，只需再次使用此命令。

IF you pick the wrong (Green) door 5 times, you get kicked from the bot with a 719 error and a 6h 2h cooldown.
如果你选错（绿色）门 5 次，你会被机器人踢出，出现 719 错误，并进入 6 小时 2 小时冷却。
If you manually exit with the D Key, or close the window you get a 24hr 2hr cooldown, do not do this.
如果你用 D 键手动退出，或关闭窗口，你会进入 24 小时 2 小时冷却，不要这样做。

The “barcode” black and white sections are ladders, touching them gives a 707 error and a 6h 2h cooldown.
“条形码”黑白区域是梯子，触碰它们会出现 707 错误，并进入 6 小时 2 小时冷却。

Notes, Theories
备注、理论

  • The green is the unclean area. When you go over it it will turn gray
    绿色区域是未清洁区域。当你走过之后，它会变成灰色
  • Your battery reduces every tile move (but does not go below 17.5%)
    你每移动一格，电池电量都会减少（但不会低于 17.5%）
  • The green lines indicate doors that you can "knock" on.
    绿色线条表示你可以“敲”的门。
  • If you pick the wrong (Green) door 5 times, you get kicked from the bot with a 719 error and a 6h cooldown.
    如果你选错（绿色）门 5 次，你就会被机器人踢出，出现 719 错误，并进入 6 小时冷却。
  • The yellow doors can be opened, and you can go inside the gray floor rooms that look closed off at first, one room has the Air system in it, at random.
    黄色门可以打开，你可以进入那些一开始看起来封闭的灰色地板房间，其中一个房间里随机有空气系统。

Current theory based on the hint is to collect all dirt (do NOT knock on ANY doors) and while doing so open any tech doors (the yellow ones) along the route to identify where your air system spawns. Once you have collected all dust, return to the air system, place the robot on top of the system, then press the red trashcan icon to ‘drop dirt’ into the air system, hopefully triggering the Air Emergency. We are unsure if we should go off the stairs for a 6 hour timer or return to dock for a 24 hour timer once dirt has been dropped.
根据提示，当前理论是收集所有污垢（不要敲任何门），同时沿途打开任何科技门（黄色门），以确定你的空气系统生成在哪里。收集完所有灰尘后，返回空气系统，把机器人放在系统上方，然后按红色垃圾桶图标，将“污垢”丢进空气系统，希望能触发空气紧急事件。我们不确定在丢下污垢后，是应该离开楼梯等待 6 小时计时，还是返回 dock 等待 24 小时计时。

Current theory is now; collect dirt, dump on air system and disconnect in one way or another, wait for silver odyssey to say air system is fixed, get to tech deck in elevator, find the documents, return them to your room, youll get DCed for doing this, so itll take 3 days.
现在的理论是：收集污垢，倒进空气系统，并以某种方式断开连接，等待 silver odyssey 说空气系统已修复，乘电梯到科技甲板，找到文件，把它们送回你的房间，你这样做会被断开连接，所以需要 3 天。


Solution
解决方案

Each location for the air system, your own door, diaries etc are all unique to the player, but they are static.
空气系统的每个位置、你自己的门、日记等，对玩家来说都是独一无二的，但它们是静态的。
so, if you find the air vent at place A, it will always be at place A.
所以，如果你在 A 地点找到了通风口，它就永远会在 A 地点。

There are system lockouts for knocking on doors. There is a timeout after the first knock, so move fast after you knock one door. You can get 6 or 7 at max speed before being forced out.
敲门有系统锁定机制。第一次敲门后会有一个超时，所以敲了一扇门后要快速行动。以最快速度你可以敲到 6 或 7 扇门，然后就会被强制退出。
Stepping on the tiles that are striped (black/white) are ladders and will trigger a lockout.
踩到有条纹（黑/白）的地砖是梯子，会触发锁定。
Disconnecting triggers a lockout.
断开连接会触发锁定。
Going back to the original start and finishing triggers a lockout.
回到最初的起点并完成会触发锁定。

1 - Clean the entire floor and then dump the dirt on the air system block by placing the roomba on the air system and using your mouse to click the trash can icon on the right of the GUI next to ‘Waste bin capacity’ (if you need a visual reference open the ‘Notes, Theories’ section above), then go to the elevator and attempt to move to a different floor. It will say “wait 24 more hours”.
1 - 清洁整个楼层，然后把 Roomba 放在空气系统上，用鼠标点击 GUI 右侧“垃圾箱容量”旁边的垃圾桶图标，将污垢倾倒到空气系统方块上（如果你需要视觉参考，请打开上方的“笔记、理论”部分），然后去电梯并尝试移动到其他楼层。它会显示“再等 24 小时”。

2 - Knock on doors until you get the notification that someone knocked on your door, and note the location. (you will need to know this for later steps)
2 - 敲门，直到你收到有人敲了你门的通知，并记下位置。（后续步骤中你会需要知道这个位置）

3 - Wait for the Silver Odyssey Ship Channel to message, to allow you onto the tech floor: (message shown below)((will also give “My name is roomba” achievement))
3 - 等待 Silver Odyssey Ship Channel 发来消息，允许你进入技术层：（消息如下所示）（（还会获得“My name is roomba”成就））

4 - Move to the tech floor and collect 1/2/3 diaries and return them to your door. You can only carry one diary at a time. Handing over a diary triggers a 24h lock until you can use the roomba again.
4 - 前往技术层，收集 1/2/3 号日记并将它们送回你的门口。你一次只能携带一本日记。交出一本日记会触发 24 小时锁定，直到你可以再次使用 roomba。

EDIT 04/06/26 - Handing over a diary only triggers a 2h lock now, reduced from the previous 24h.
编辑于 04/06/26 - 交出一本日记现在只会触发 2 小时锁定，已从之前的 24 小时缩短。

5 - The red diary (3) gives an exe file that when run, unlocks disk fragment 20. Completing the data recovery!
5 - 红色日记（3）会提供一个 exe 文件，运行后会解锁磁盘碎片 20。完成数据恢复！

YOU MUST READ/ACCESS ALL 3 ITEMS TO PROGRESS.
你必须阅读/访问全部 3 个物品才能继续推进。




On 2nd of April the site was updated, adding a third floor which contains cargo. The cleaner bot can only access one layer of boxes, so we need something to move them. One of the diaries suggests a fetcher bot for cargo, be sure to have read it otherwise you cannot proceed. (IF you can't access the cargo area or use the command below, open the 3 files again and try again)
4 月 2 日，网站进行了更新，新增了一个包含货物的第三层。清洁机器人只能接触到一层箱子，所以我们需要某种东西来移动它们。其中一本日记提到了用于货物的取物机器人，请务必读过它，否则你无法继续推进。（如果你无法进入货物区域或使用下面的命令，请再次打开这 3 个文件并重试）

connect fetcher_242 --password=admin

Then by looking at f2_sys_summary we can see to run
然后通过查看 f2_sys_summary，我们可以看到要运行

Test_mode 1

This gives the same mix and match minigame as before, but more complex. Again, the correct answer is different each run.
这会给出和之前一样的混搭小游戏，但更复杂。同样，每次运行时的正确答案都不同。


UPDATE: THE BELOW HACK PUZZLE IS NOW THE SAME AS THE PREVIOUS STEP. (MADE EASIER)
更新：下面的黑客谜题现在与上一步相同。（已变得更简单）

E.g.
例如
13-2 ADM Moro 1 BSC
3-47 ADM Moro 1 BSC
13-2 RDMM Moro 1 BSC
13-2 ADM Rose 1 BSC
13-2 ADM Moro 2 BSC
13-2 ADM Moro 1 MTNS

There is a 20 min timer on failure.
失败时有 20 分钟计时。
There are two approaches to the puzzle, change one item at a time, with three options, you can eliminate a whole row in two commands, making it end as a 50:50 with the 4th protocol.
这个谜题有两种解法：一次只改一个条目，共有三个选项，你可以用两条指令排除一整行，这样到第 4 个协议时就会变成 50:50。

You can also change all of the entries and hope you get a 5/5 mismatch, to eliminate those 5. But that's less consistent.
你也可以把所有条目都改掉，寄希望于得到 5/5 的不匹配，从而排除这 5 个。但这样稳定性较差。

Run the above list of commands, slowly 1 by one, if the number of mismatches goes DOWN, then keep that new value. If it stays the same, then you know both values tried are wrong, so the third is the answer.
依次缓慢执行上面的指令列表，如果不匹配数量下降，就保留这个新值。如果保持不变，那么你就知道尝试的两个值都是错的，所以第三个就是答案。

I.e.
即：

13-2 ADM Moro 1 BSC - 5 Wrong
13-2 ADM Moro 1 BSC - 5 错误
3-47 ADM Moro 1 BSC - 4 Wrong
3-47 ADM Moro 1 BSC - 4 错误

(this means 3-47 is correct, keep it!)
（这意味着 3-47 是正确的，保留它！）

3-47 ADM Moro 1 BSC - 4 Wrong
3-47 ADM Moro 1 BSC - 4 错误
3-47 RDMM Moro 1 BSC - 4 Wrong
3-47 RDMM Moro 1 BSC - 4 错误

(this means both ADM and RDMM are wrong. So the 2nd answer is CMU.)
（这意味着 ADM 和 RDMM 都是错误的。所以第二个答案是 CMU。）

Once successful, enter: =
成功后，输入：=

f2_manual_test


This allows control and movement of the cargobot.
这样可以控制和移动货运机器人。

Running out of battery gives a 4hr timeout.
电池耗尽会触发 4 小时超时。
Manually disconnecting gives 4hr timeout.
手动断开连接会触发 4 小时超时。

Finishing at the home tile gives a 10hr timeout.
在起始地块完成会触发 10 小时超时。

Only some actions use battery charge on the Logistics Robot:
物流机器人只有部分操作会消耗电池电量：

  • Loading a container
    装载容器
  • Moving one tile while carrying a container
    携带容器移动一个地块

This is the ideal “completed” layout, giving access to every container.
这是理想的“已完成”布局，可访问每个容器。


We need to move the containers into a layout so that the cleanerbot can access and search every one.
我们需要把容器重新摆放成一个布局，好让清洁机器人能够到并逐个搜查它们。
Use the cleanerbot command to control the bot, elevator to floor 3, then use it to search the containers that you’ve moved.
使用 cleanerbot 命令控制机器人，乘电梯到 3 楼，然后用它搜查你搬动过的容器。

cb_direct_control

We are looking for Hacker Data, and when you find it, it will show in the event log:
我们要找的是黑客数据，找到后它会显示在事件日志中：

As we did with the diaries, take the file back to your door. This will give you a new .exe file in the Silver Odyssey folder called “5CRYPt0L (3)” and 800 credits.
就像我们处理日记时那样，把文件带回你的门口。这会在 Silver Odyssey 文件夹中给你一个新的 .exe 文件，名为“5CRYPt0L (3)”，以及 800 信用点。

Trying to run the .exe file at this point in the progression returns an “ACCESS DENIED” message. It will be useful later in Act 3.
在流程进行到此时尝试运行该 .exe 文件会返回“ACCESS DENIED”消息。它在第三幕中会派上用场。

Once you have the 5CRYPt0L (3) and confirm you get an access denied due to software versioning, you can proceed to Act 3 via purchasing a ticket or landing/exiting the ship and following the guide for Act 3 Repnode M7 here
一旦你拿到 5CRYPt0L (3) 并确认因软件版本问题而收到访问被拒绝的提示，你就可以通过购买门票或降落/离开飞船并按照此处第三幕 Repnode M7 的指南继续进入第三幕


Why not hop over to the discord and join in the discussions and help others that are stuck?
何不跳到 discord 上加入讨论，并帮助那些卡住的人呢？
Important Links
重要链接

Check out our (nearly complete) list of Forerunner rank users that helped crack this ARG?
来看看我们（几乎完整的）先驱者等级用户名单，他们帮助破解了这个 ARG？
Player Ranks
玩家等级

BACK TO MAIN GUIDE
返回主指南

Fragment Timeline
碎片时间线

Now we have decrypted/repaired the drive we can now access the file ‘EVID-CIS-MAIN-C2R1856.2’, double-click it to enter into a timeline with audio clips, video clips and some pictures. These are referred to as “FRAGMENTS” (Frags)
现在我们已经解密/修复了驱动器，可以访问文件“EVID-CIS-MAIN-C2R1856.2”，双击它即可进入一个包含音频片段、视频片段和一些图片的时间线。这些被称为“碎片”（Frags）

There are a total of 20 discovered Fragments, and it appears we may need to progress through and unlock all 20.
目前共发现了 20 个碎片，看起来我们可能需要逐步推进并解锁全部 20 个。

Interestingly on the 6th of February, they added new symbols to the timeline. These symbols appear to match symbols in some of the new personnel profiles.
有趣的是，在 2 月 6 日，他们向时间线添加了新的符号。这些符号似乎与一些新人员档案中的符号相匹配。
